exceptions.reason: The bar writes `aria-orientation`, and CSS selects `[aria-orientation]`. It writes no `data-modal`, which repeats a prop, and no `data-has-submenu-open`: `:has([aria-expanded="true"])` selects a bar with an open menu (rule 8.15). The family has no namespace of constants (rule 8.10).

`Menubar.test.ts` tests the bar: its role and its one tab stop, the keys of the bar, a disabled trigger, the open of a menu with the key across the bar, the move to another menu at a pointer move, at a tap and at an arrow key, the outside press, and the modal state.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to give it to the menus of the menubar as the id of their root, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the menubar, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
